input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: Searches for MFN-type language ("most favoured nation", "no less favourable", "favourable/favorable", "best", "price", "other customers", "third part") return nothing resembling a pricing-parity or best-terms undertaking. The fees clause (§ 11) simply requires payment per the Fee Schedule, and § 20 (General Matters) contains only time-of-essence and notice provisions. There is accordingly no obligation on Sparkling (as Customer) to offer Garman terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers, which matches the preferred position of no MFN burdening the Customer. No Vendor-granted MFN exists in our favour either, but that is a commercial upside we are not required to flag under this rule.
